definitions.explanation: excessively desirous of acquiring wealth or possessions
having a strong appetite or enthusiasm for learning, growth, or achievement

examples.japanese: {貪欲|どんよく}な{金持|かねも}ち。
{貪欲|どんよく}に{利益|りえき}を{追求|ついきゅう}する。
{彼|かれ}は{知識|ちしき}に{貪欲|どんよく}だ。
{成長|せいちょう}に{貪欲|どんよく}な{姿勢|しせい}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: An eager attitude toward growth is important.

examples.japanese: {勝利|しょうり}に{貪欲|どんよく}なチームが{優勝|ゆうしょう}する。
examples.english: The team hungry for victory wins the championship.

examples.japanese: {貪欲|どんよく}に{学|まな}ぶ{姿勢|しせい}を{持|も}ち{続|つづ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to keep an eager attitude toward learning.

notes:
SENSE 1 - NEGATIVE (greed):
- {貪欲|どんよく}な{人|ひと} (greedy person)
- {貪欲|どんよく}さ (greediness)
One of the Seven Deadly Sins in Christianity.

SENSE 2 - POSITIVE (eagerness):
- {知識|ちしき}に{貪欲|どんよく} (hungry for knowledge)
- {成長|せいちょう}に{貪欲|どんよく} (eager for growth)
- {勝利|しょうり}に{貪欲|どんよく} (hungry for victory)
In this usage, implies admirable drive and ambition.

ALTERNATE READING:
Also read as どんよく (more common) or たんよく (literary).

FORMS:
- Adverb: {貪欲|どんよく}に
- Noun form: {貪欲|どんよく}さ
